Product Description
Evenflo Classic bottles and nipples provide a complete line of feeding solutions for your baby's changing needs. The Classic Nipples are made from soft silicone and feature Micro Air Vents. These special vents are designed to prevent nipple collapse, and promote a more comfortable feeding experience for baby. Designed for easy assembly and leak- free feeding these nipples are compatible with all Evenflo standard neck bottles. Rest assured, Evenflo baby bottle nipples are 100% free of BPA, polycarbonates, PVC and phthalates, and are also made of food grade material.
Brand Story
By Evenflo
From the Manufacturer
Evenflo classic silicone nipples with sensitive response sense baby's pressure and respond with the right amount of liquid and micro air vents reduce gas.

original_text.description: Make mealtime fun and support healthy eating habits with My First Meal Pal tableware. This 15-piece set includes three of each: divided plates, bowls, cups, forks, and spoons. The durable design is intended for everyday use by toddlers and children in a home, daycare of classroom environment. Kid-sized tableware encourages the development of fine motor skills, coordination, and independence through self-feeding. Plates and bowls are proportionally sized including deep walls for easy scooping and a non-skid base for added traction during mealtime. Stainless steel forks and spoons have rounded edges for safety and feature an ergonomic handle with built-in support to keep the utensil tips off the table. Drinking cups are easy for little hands to hold and allows drinking from any side. Cups, bowls, and plates feature a smooth interior, free of texture, making these items easy to clean. The set is top rack dishwasher safe and stacks to save space for storage. Our tableware is BPA free, FDA and CPSIA compliant. At ECR4Kids, we’re committed to safety, testing, and regulatory compliance to ensure our products meet or exceed industry standards. You and your kids deserve the absolute best for a brighter way to play, share, learn and grow.

Color foods, dyes, and/or other liquids may cause discoloration and staining.

original_text.title: HALO 100% Cotton Sleepsack Swaddle, 3-Way Adjustable Wearable Blanket, TOG 1.5, Cream, Preemie
original_text.description: The HALO Sleep Sack Swaddle replaces loose blankets in the crib that can cover your baby's face and interfere with breathing. In addition to helping your baby sleep safer, it helps him sleep better, too. Its adjustable swaddle wrap immobilizes your baby's arms to prevent the "Moro" or startle reflex. And, it is the only 3-way adjustable swaddle that adjusts to your baby's sleep style. Swaddle arms in, hands-to-face, one or both arms out to ensure baby's best sleep and an easy and gentle transition to the Sleep Sack wearable blanket when it is time to stop swaddling. Used in hospitals nationwide, the Halo Sleep Sack Swaddle is the #1 choice of hospitals and is recognized as "Hip Healthy" by the International Hip Dysplasia Institute. Its strong adjustable fasteners ensure a perfect fit and resist breakouts for more secure swaddling. Plus, its innovative zipper, unzips from the bottom allowing your baby to stay swaddled for easy diaper changes. HALO also proudly supports non-profit organizations like First Candle/SIDS Alliance. Use over regular sleepwear to take the place of loose blankets. Discontinue swaddling when the baby shows signs of rolling over or breaking out of the swaddle wrap. 100% cotton interlock. TOG: 1.5 Size small fits 13-18 lbs. Durable Product.
features: The original wearable blanket replaces loose blankets in the crib for a safer environment; the 3-way swaddle ensures your baby's best sleep and an easy transition when it's time to stop swaddling; number 1 choice of hospital nurseries to promote safe sleep

Made with 100% cotton fabric, double knit construction is soft and a little stretchy, perfect for swaddling; TOG Rating of 1.5 offering the right comfort for moderate seasons or climates, and can be layered with warmer sleepwear for cooler temperatures

Generously sized swaddle fasteners offer adjustability for a perfect fit; 3-way adjustable swaddle allows Arms-In to reduce startle reflex, One-Arm-Out for self-soothing, and Two-Arms-Out for easy transition from swaddling to Halo's SleepSack
Inverted zipper opens from the bottom for easy diaper changes without undoing the swaddle; sleeveless to reduce the risk of overheating; arm and neck openings sized for a safer fit

Available here in Small size designed for babies weighing between 13 and 18 pounds who are generally 3-6 months old and 23-26 inches long; discontinue swaddling when the baby shows signs of rolling over or breaking out of the swaddle wrap.

Our designers seek to create durable bedding and accessories that not only last, but complements rooms of all shapes and sizes

Our premium blend of cotton and polyester ensures each piece can withstand frequent circulation over time
GORGEOUS PATTERNS - You won’t find any monotone prints here! Our in-house designers closely monitor the evolving trends in nursery design and style to make sure our product stays current and versatile. From a gorgeous, detailed library of fabrics including woven stripes, ginghams and plaids that blend beautifully with damask velvets, crushed taffeta and lush embroideries, fantastic designs are created having timeless appeal and heirloom quality.

original_text.title: Cybex Sirona S with Convertible Car Seat, 360° Rotating Seat, Rear-Facing or Forward-Facing Car Seat, Easy Installation, SensorSafe Chest Clip, Instant Safety Alerts, Urban Black
original_text.description: The CYBEX Sirona S is the first convertible car seat in the U.S. to feature an innovative 360° rotatable seat with a load leg, making switching between rear-facing and forward-facing positions quick and easy. This rotatable seat, along with magnetic buckle holders, makes it easy to get your child in and out. Designed for safety, the Sirona S features a steel-reinforced frame and anti-rebound design that reduces car seat rebound movement. Linear side-impact protection system absorbs up to 25% more impact in a collision when compared to the same car seat without L.S.P. extended. A one-time belt installation secures both forward and rear-facing positions. Our EasyLock™ Bar works with your vehicle belt for easy and secure installation, while the dual-level indicators ensure the car seat is at the proper angle. Adjust your Sirona S as your child grows, with a 12-position headrest with no-rethread harness. SensorSafe™ technology in the chest clip syncs automatically with your mobile app and provides alerts of unsafe situations, including if a child unbuckles themselves; if the back seat is too warm or cold, if a child has been seated for too long, or if the driver accidentally leaves the child behind.
features: Convertible Car Seat: The first car seat in the U.S to feature an innovative 360° rotatable seat, the Sirona S makes it quick and easy to switch between rear-facing and forward-facing positions and get your child in and out of the car.

EasyLock Bar: Reduces the force needed up to 4x for simple and secure car seat installation. Dual-level indicators ensure that your car seat is at the correct recline angle while our load leg can reduce rotation in certain crashes by up to 30%.

SensorSafe: Built into the chest clip, SensorSafe provides app alerts if a child unbuckles themselves; if the back seat has become too warm or too cold, if a child has been seated for too long, or if the driver accidentally leaves the child behind.

Superior Protection: Linear side-impact protection (L.S.P.) absorbs up to 25% more impact in a collision compared to the same car seat without L.S.P. extended while the anti-rebound design reduces car seat rebound movement in the event of a crash.

Adjustable Headrest: Make sure your car seat is always a perfect fit with 12 different headrest positions. The Sirona S harness adjusts without re-threading, making it easier to adjust the height of the shoulder straps as your child grows.

Safety 1st believes parenting should have fewer worries and more joyful moments. We've designed and tested the Chase's structural integrity to withstand approximately two times the energy of the Federal Crash Test Standard. It also exceeds Evenflo's own rigorous side impact testing standards. . Your child will also appreciate that the integrated cup holders to keep their snacks and drinks secure. The soft, machine washable seat pad allows for easy cleanup of any messes. The lightweight design comes equipped with an easy to use LATCH system, including tether, for easy installation and movement between multiple vehicles. The Evenflo Chase LX 2-in-1 Harness Booster Car Seat for infants and toddlers is designed, engineered, tested, molded and assembled in the United States. For almost a century, Evenflo has been a leader in safety, innovation and education. The Evenflo Chase LX adheres to that mission in providing a convertible car seat that combines safety, comfort and ease for the ultimate value in child restraints. Do not use this restraint in the front seat of a vehicle equipped with an air bag. Do not allow a child in a vehicle to have objects such as lollipops or ice cream on a stick. original_text.description: The LILLEbaby Essentials baby carrier combines the basics of babywearing with LILLEbaby's signature commitment to quality and style. This classically constructed 4-position carrier, made from our softest, most durable cotton, is the perfect addition to any baby carrier collection - designed for adventure, crafted with style, and yours to keep on hand, in the car, on the go, wherever you go. LILLEbaby's commitment to providing efficient, thoughtfully designed carriers that bring the love of babywearing to households everywhere is evident in the Essentials industry-leading features, including 3-way adjustable straps that can be crossed or adjusted for easy breastfeeding access and our signature large cargo pocket to store all of your parenting necessities. FEATURES: 1. FOUR ERGONOMIC CARRYING POSITIONS - The Essentials provides four carrying options - Front - Infant (with the addition of the infant insert - coming soon), Front - Facing In, Hip, and Back. The ESSENTIALS is designed to accommodate children from 7-45lbs. 2. PERFECT FIT ADJUSTERS (NEW!) - The Essentials is outfitted with Perfect Fit Adjusters, which allow the wearer to adjust the length of the shoulder straps and positioning of the carrier panel to achieve a truly customized fit. 3. TWO-WAY STRAP - Our two-way straps enable wearers to carry "backpack style" or with straps crossed in the back. Dual adjustment buckles simplify breastfeeding and adjusting straps on the go. 4. SLEEPING HOOD - The Essentials all-weather sleeping hood is constructed from a soft, breathable mesh, which provides excellent air flow for your sleeping baby and improved visibility for parents. 5. POCKETS - Our large zippered storage pocket offers amble storage space. This simplified carrier design is a beautiful compliment to the LILLEbaby COMPLETE collection, for those who prefer to keep a variety of carriers on hand or prefer the classic 4-position carrier construction
features: FOUR POSITIONS: The LÍLLÉbaby ESSENTIALS Original carrier is made from soft, durable cotton and easily transitions between four ergonomic carry styles and is the perfect on-the-go babywearing solution

VERSATILE CARRYING: With two-way straps allowing you to carry backpack style or forwards, the LÍLLÉbaby ESSENTIALS Baby Carrier provides comfort & support for you and your child no matter where you go

HANDS-FREE COMFORT: When on-the-go, LÍLLÉbaby's baby carriers & toddler carriers let you hold your child in comfort and style. Adjustable side panels widen & narrow the seat for comfortable hip positioning.

NATURAL BOND: LÍLLÉbaby makes baby products that bring functional style to parents. We want parents to be able to keep baby close while building a natural bond with comfortable baby carriers and slings.

FOR LÍLLÉBABY innovation is always top of mind. We won’t rest until every caretaker has access to the best babywearing solutions, allowing families to keep comfort, closeness, and independence in balance.

original_text.description: Primo viaggio 4/35 rear facing infant car seat takes the Peg Perego experience in child restraint systems to a new and improved level of safety and design. This car seat will accommodate a baby from 4 to 35 pounds and up to 32" tall. Energy absorbing EPS lined shell enhances protection and is perforated to guarantee maximum air circulation. Dual stage cushion system includes two cushions. Well fitted upholstery features the best of Italian textile and tailoring tradition. The primo viaggio offers a 5 point harness and comes with a large adjustable hood that protects baby from the elements. It is travel system compatible and attaches easily to any Peg Perego stroller without adapters. It can be used without the included base for your convenience when traveling in taxis or airplanes. Additional base sold separately. Made in Italy.

JEWL features biometric sizing that helps parents know which stage is best for their growing child. Science aside, there’s also a variety of Boon approved colors to choose from. After all, when your baby’s mastering self-soothing, they might as well look great doing it.

features: AWARD WINNING! Made in the USA, our safety covers are made from a non-conductive BPA-free recyclable plastic with a child resistant lock, contains no small parts and no bright colors. Like every baby proofing device, it does not replace adult supervision.

PROTECT YOUR CHILD FROM ELECTRIC SHOCK or BURN caused by the free end of a plugged-in USB charger. It is a hazard which sends over 200 children annually to the emergency room. Dramatically reduce the risk of electric injury to your child by your USB charger by snapping on a Watch Your Mouth USB charger safety cover. It clips onto and encapsulates the free metal connector end of most standard USB cords, preventing tampering by curious hands and mouths.

DEVELOPED BY DOCTORS, RESEARCH-BASED. Watch Your Mouth was created by a husband and wife doctor duo, along with engineers, designers, and input from parents. Their research shows devastating and life-threatening injury and has found that while children under 5 years old are most susceptible, a staggering number of adults have been left with scars by coming in to contact with the metal end of a plugged-in charger. Watch Your Mouth also prevents pet injuries and furniture/carpet damage.

COMPATIBLE WITH MOST STANDARD USB Chargers for personal electronic devices, including but not limited to Lightning, USB-C, Micro and Mini USBs with cords under 6.2mm in diameter. This includes flat charger cables and off-center connectors. Charging your device? Simply open your WATCH YOUR MOUTH, slide your charger along the opening grooves to connect it to your personal electronic device, and snap it closed to hug the wire.

MADE IN THE USA and PATENT-PENDING: THE FIRST AND ONLY child-safe device that protects the free end of a USB charger from being tampered with. With more chargers purchased through third-party markets, it is critical now more than ever that USB chargers are safeguarded away from young children who are curious and often explore new objects with their mouths. Our device protects against extended skin and jewelry contact with your charger connector which can cause skin ulcerations or electric burns.

items.description:
什么是Minky面料？
Minky是一种特别柔软、温暖且轻盈的毛绒面料，属于一种聚酯纤维，触感如同真正的水貂，柔软细腻，堪比羊绒。
尺寸有多大？
这款Minky汽车座椅遮阳罩长40英寸，宽29英寸。可调节的魔术贴带设计可覆盖大多数带有把手的汽车座椅。但由于这款遮阳罩不能平铺在汽车座椅上，因此最好的方式是询问拥有相同婴儿汽车座椅的其他父母，以了解它是否合适。它也可以用作额外的婴儿毯子、婴儿背带罩、汽车座椅毯子、更换垫罩，或由哺乳妈妈作为哺乳罩或斗篷使用。
这款婴儿汽车座椅遮阳罩在冬天够暖和吗？
这款婴儿汽车座椅遮阳罩厚度为0.1英寸，双层设计足够应对春秋季节使用。如果您所在地区的冬天特别寒冷，请给宝宝多加一条毯子。
请不要在汽车座椅上让您的孩子无人看管。
这款遮阳罩在有风的散步时表现如何？
有时它会被风吹起，但面料的重量以及魔术贴挂环有助于防止它被吹走。在特别有风的日子里，我们建议将婴儿汽车座椅罩的角落塞进汽车座椅的内衬中。
这款婴儿遮阳罩是否防水？
面料具有防水性能，可以在小雨中保持宝宝温暖且干燥。但长时间暴露在水中会吸收水分，因此我们不建议将其作为长期防雨的手段。
这款遮阳罩是否可以机洗和使用烘干机？
是的，它在洗衣机的轻柔模式下表现良好。使用冷水和温和洗涤剂。不要使用柔顺剂或漂白剂。低温烘干；如果可能的话，最好挂起来晾干。

original_text.title: Dear Baby Gear Baby Car Seat Canopy, Tan Farm Life Animals and Barns, Red Minky
original_text.description:
What is minky?
Minky is a particularly soft, warm & lightweight fleece fabric, a form of polyester that resembles real mink in touch and as soft & silky as cashmere.
How big is it?
This minky carseat canopy cover measures 40 inch long and 29 inch wide. The adjustable Velcro straps are designed to cover most carseat that has a handle. But because this canopy doesn't lay flat on the carseat, the best way to know how it fits is to ask other parents who have the same baby carseat that you have.It can also be used as an extra baby blanket, baby carrier cover, carseat blanket, changing pad cover, or worn by a nursing mother as breastfeeding cover or poncho.
Is this warm enough for winter?
This baby car seat canopy is 0.1 inch thick and has a double layer enough for spring and fall use. If your winters are exceptionally cold, please bundle up your baby with an extra blanket.
Please do not leave your child unattended while covered up in the carseat.
How will this do on windy walks?
Sometimes it blows up but the weight of the fabric along with its Velcro hanger helps not to blow it away. On especially windy days, we recommend tucking the corners of your baby carseat cover into the liner on your car seat.
Is this baby cover car seat waterproof?
The fabric is water resistant and will keep your baby warm & dry in a light sprinkle. It would absorb water with prolonged exposure, so we don't suggest using this as a means of long-term rain protection.
Is it machine washable and dryer-safe?
Yes, it holds up well in the washing machine on gentle cycle. Use cold water & mild detergent. No fabric softeners or bleach. Tumble dry on low heat; but if possible, hang to dry.

Care instructions: Machine Wash Gentle Cycle, Cold Water, Mild Detergent Safe for Delicate Baby Skin. Tumble Dry Low Heat, Remove Promptly. Do Not Iron or Press. Do Not Dry Clean.

original_text.description:
Couches and beds are the perfect size for pet owners, but not always the perfect size for their pets. Not to mention, jumping up on furniture to sit with you can be seriously damaging to aging dogs’ knees and hips. So if your furniture is too tall for your furry member of the family, throw them a bone with Smooth Steps! Our pet stairs are wide and deep with a shallow 9" height, which is perfect for small pups with short legs and larger, aging dogs with joint problems.
Smooth Steps are wrapped in a soft layer of luxurious, elegant leather that complements all sorts of home décor, but beneath the plush surface is a tough, dense open cell foam that provides consistent, dependable strength and support to dogs of all sizes. The ultra-lightweight foam makes for easy repositioning and storage when not in use. The bottom is covered in grippy beads for extra stability and security, and the leather covers can be removed for easy cleaning.
Best of all, Smooth Steps are stackable! Buy a second one to increase the overall height to 13.5" for an extra boost.

items.description:
产品描述
Dingo 品牌结合了强大的风味和益处，创造出骨头、咬胶和零食，确保你和你的狗狗会想要更多。拥有各种形状和风味，为任何体型的狗狗提供选择。Dingo 小型牙龈骨头提供一种小型零食或咬胶，采用狗狗喜爱的经典骨头形状。由真实鸡肉制成，Dingo 牙龈骨头，为全面护理，是一种日常口腔健康咬胶，通过咀嚼的自然作用减少牙结石和牙菌斑，并清新口气，这是你和你的狗狗都会为之微笑的事。每块小咬胶中间都含有真实鸡肉，为你的狗狗带来美味，让它们摇尾巴！每天喂食一块 Dingo 牙龈骨头作为零食或点心。始终提供充足的饮用水。用可密封袋保持咬胶的新鲜。本包装包含 6 小型牙龈骨头。
亚马逊.com
骨头背后的故事
在 1990 年代，Dingo 品牌始于一位名叫 Les 的男人和他的狗 Dingo。像大多数狗狗一样，Dingo 有本能的啃咬需求，但令他的主人失望的是，Dingo 喜欢啃咬家具和破坏鞋子。为了改善 Dingo 的行为问题，Les 尝试用牛皮骨头代替鞋子。不幸的是，Dingo 并不喜欢这些传统的牛皮咬胶。而不是放弃希望，Les 寻找替代方案。巧合的是，Les 的妻子在一家肉干公司工作，Dingo 非常喜欢肉干零食。由于 Dingo 对肉干的喜爱，Les 开始将传统的牛皮骨头浸泡在水中，并在其中填充肉干，让 Dingo 能看到边缘的肉干。就这样，Dingo 骨头诞生了。最终，Dingo 有了它喜爱的零食，同时还能满足它的啃咬需求。现在你的狗狗可以享受原始的 Dingo 咬胶，以小型骨头的形式。
狗狗喜爱的健康零食
传统的牛皮骨头是一种耐用、可食用的骨头，常作为狗狗的零食。通过 Dingo 小型包装，狗狗可以享受到清洁牙齿和调理牙龈的益处，同时也能享受到 Dingo 骨头带来的肉味。因为所有 Dingo 骨头都是用真实肉在中间手工绑扎的，它们为你的狗狗提供最高质量的零食。这种零食易于消化，柔软到不会损伤狗狗的牙齿，使其成为一种安全且健康的骨头，你的狗狗会喜欢。
独一无二
在 1997 年，Dingo 品牌获得了对传统狗咬胶三十多年来最合逻辑的改进的专利。由于其中间的肉质，Dingo 骨头是市场上唯一的产品。这使狗狗能够体验一种独特的零食，其创新性和独特性使其区别于传统的牛皮骨头。尽管竞争对手尝试模仿 Dingo 骨头，但没有其他产品能将牛皮与中间的真肉结合，创造出更持久的零食，鼓励你的狗狗啃完整块骨头。
Dingo 有各种类型！
Dingo 有不同的形状、风味和功能性形式：
Dingo 打结骨头
Dingo 卷、片和扭结
Dingo 创意形状
Dingo 天然系列
Dingo 软糯系列
Dingo 健康美味咬胶

original_text.title: Dingo Dental Bones Dog Chews
original_text.description:
Product Description
The Dingo brand combines powerful flavors and benefits to create bones, chews and treats that are sure to keep you and your dog wanting more. With a wide variety of shapes and flavors, there are options for any size companion. Dingo Mini Dental Bones give you a small treat or chew in the classic bone shape dogs love. Made with real chicken, Dingo Dental Bones, for Total Care, are a daily oral health chew that reduces tartar and plaque and freshens breath due to the natural action of chewing, and that’s something you and your pup can smile about. Each small chew is made with real chicken in the middle, giving your pup flavor that will have their tails wagging! Feed one Dingo Dental Bone a day as a treat or snack. Always provide plenty of fresh drinking water. Keep your chews fresh with the resealable pouch. This package contains 6 Small Dental Bones.
Amazon.com
The Story Behind the Bone
In the 1990's, the Dingo brand started with a man named Les and his dog, Dingo. Like most dogs, Dingo had an instinctual need to chew, and to his owner's dismay, Dingo enjoyed gnawing on furniture and destroying shoes. In hopes of fixing Dingo's behavioral problems, Les attempted replacing shoes with rawhide bones. Unfortunately, Dingo was not a fan of these traditional rawhide chews. Rather than giving up hope, Les searched for an alternate solution. Coincidentally, Les's wife worked for a jerky company, and Dingo loved the jerky treats. Due to Dingo's adoration of the jerky, Les began soaking the traditional rawhide bones in water and filling them with jerky, leaving some jerky around the edges for Dingo to see. And with that, the Dingo bone was born. Finally, Dingo had a treat that he loved, while still being able to fulfill his chewing needs. Now your dog can enjoy the original Dingo chew in the form of mini bones.
The Healthy Treat Dogs Love
The traditional rawhide bone is a durable, edible bone that serves as a common treat for dogs. With the Dingo Mini Packs, dogs reap the dental benefits of teeth cleansing and gum conditioning, while also enjoying the meaty flavor that the Dingo bone ensures. Because all Dingo bones are hand tied with real meat in the middle, they provide the highest quality treat for your dog. This treat is both easily digestible and soft enough not to damage dogs' teeth, making it a safe and healthy bone that your dog will love.
One of a Kind
In 1997, the Dingo brand was granted a patent for the single most logical improvement on the rawhide dog chew in thirty years. Due to its meat in the middle quality, the Dingo bone is the only product of its kind on the market. This allows dogs to experience a unique treat that's innovation and uniqueness separates it from traditional rawhide bones. Although competitors have attempted to mimic the Dingo bone, no other product combines rawhide with real meat in the middle to create a longer-lasting treat that encourages your dog to chew through the entire bone.
Dingo comes in various types!
Dingo comes in different shapes, flavors and functional forms:

Easily Make Plant-Based Milk Alternatives
Milkmade makes it easy to create gluten-free and vegan non-dairy milk alternatives. Patented technology extracts flavor from the raw ingredients, and then it pulverizes and filters the pulp. In less than 16 minutes at just a click of a button, your milk is ready.

A compact and modern design doesn’t crowd your counter space. The capsule container conveniently stores used capsules until you throw them away (capsules are not included).

original_text.description: The HEAD Graphene 360+ Extreme S Tennis Racquet provides a larger head and more spacious sweet spot than the Extreme MP. The 105 square inch head and open 16x19 string pattern make the Extreme S a spin machine. At 9.7 ounces unstrung, the Extreme S provides lightweight power with enlarged SPIN Grommets at the 12 o'clock position for more string movement and power. The variable 23/26/22 cross section provides the Extreme S solid stability even at a reduced weight. HEAD constructed the Extreme S with Graphene 360+. Graphene inside the head and shaft provide greater stability and energy return, while Spiralfibers in the lower hoop stretch and untwist at contact for greater flexibility and comfort. HEAD updated the Extreme design with a predominantly light grey hoop, and an Extreme yellow shaft. The Extreme S offers a lighter weight and more powerful option for those that play with a good amount of spin. Our play testers found the 105 head size a mobile compromise between traditional oversize frames and smaller mid plus racquets.

With an open 16/19 string pattern, spin grommets which allow more string movement and a powerful trampoline effect on impact with the ball, the EXTREME S is your ultimate spin machine.

features: 【Easier to Kick and Less Fatigue】Short fins are best for most snorkelers becasue they’re easier on your leg muscles. You don’t need as much power with each stroke, and each stroke will be shorter relative to using longer fins. Even though short fins generate less thrust, speed shouldn’t be a top priority for most snorkelers. You`ll be chilling at the surface most of the time, not swimming long distances through strong currents.

Easy to Practice With in a Pool】Many casual snorkelers will be accustomed to a swimming flutter kick, which requires short and fast strokes. That means kicking with a short fin will feel more familiar, and thus easier to get used to.In fact, short fins are a great way to train your legs for the flutter kick and are routinely used by swimmers for this purpose.

【Easier to Travel With】Traveling by air is much more of a hassle than it used to be. Many airlines now have increased restrictions on baggage size and weight.Short fins under 25inches are much easier to travel with as a result.

【Less Likely to Accidentally Kick Coral, Sea Life, and Other Snorkelers】Beginners can be clumsy with their feet while learning to kick. New snorkelers and divers, however, will find it much easier to maneuver in short fins. That means a short fin will decrease your chances of kicking coral, wildlife, and even your fellow snorkelers!

【How to choose a fit fins】Comfortable is King! A blade that’s too stiff will give you foot and leg cramps in short order, regardless of how perfectly they fit you! Our flippers with flexible material will give you a betterexperience. A snug fit will also reduce chafing and slipping around your ankle. Use fin socks for extra comfort, insulation, or if you’re between sizes.
